# netbox_aggregate (Data Source)

Retrieves a single aggregate from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_aggregate" "example" {
  id = 1
}

output "aggregate_id" {
  value = data.netbox_aggregate.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `date_added` (String) The date added of the aggregate.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the aggregate.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the aggregate.
- `rir_id` (Number) The ID of the rir associated with the aggregate.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the aggregate.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the aggregate.
- `created` (String) The created of the aggregate.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the aggregate, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the aggregate.
- `family` (String) The family of the aggregate.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the aggregate.
- `prefix` (String) The prefix of the aggregate.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
